title: Desktop bar
description: The groups of modules on each side of the desktop bar, in order. The Waybar config and the specimen preview both read it.

name.description: CSS class of the module in the preview, matching the name Waybar gives it.

image.description: SVG file next to the spec, filled with currentColor, drawn component.bar.image-height tall in the bar's text colour as the module's background, pinned to the module's left edge.

marker.description: Whether the module can become a marker. A marker module carries space.marker padding at its sides, so inverting it changes only its colours (0012). A module that never becomes one takes the bar style's plain-padding instead. Defaults to true.

icons.description: Waybar format icons: text shown for `{icon}` by name. Names without an icon show as themselves, such as workspace 10 as `0`.

align.description: Where the text sits inside the fixed width.

variants.description: Other formats by Waybar status, such as `muted` or `charging`.

states.description: Waybar states, such as `critical`, active when the value is below the threshold, with an optional format for the state.

stateSamples.description: Variants and states the preview shows in its state row.

sample.description: Values the preview fills the format with.

group.description: Modules that read as one group. Modules in a group are the bar style's module-gap apart, or space.cell in a phrase; groups are the style's group-gap apart unless spaceAfter says otherwise.

name.description: Group name, used as the Waybar group/<name> module and the preview class.

styles.description: Bar styles that show the group. Every style shows it when this is left out.

spaceAfter.description: Space token between this group and the next on its side. Defaults to the bar style's group-gap.

phrase.description: Whether the modules read as one phrase, such as a date and a time. A phrase's modules are space.cell apart in every style, one character, like words. Other groups take the bar style's module-gap.
